audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side is a flat 'Skill' template on all 7 rows while content win[] already gives concrete verdicts (Poppy 0-3 and 5, Soraka 4 and 6) backed by grounded content whys[]. Every row disagreed between the two layers.
audit.why: Content whys[] match the kit: Soraka self-costs HP to heal and has no mobility, so Poppy's wall-pin wins levels 1-3 and first item; Wish (R) is a global full-team heal that resets Poppy's all-in at 6 and lets stacked healing out-sustain her late — matching winRate 53.44% (owner favored overall, but the enemy has two real windows).
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0-3,5].side to 'Poppy' and phases[4,6].side to 'Soraka', rewriting each why to state the specific reason instead of the generic ability-threat template.

audit.why: spikes[] correctly identifies the level-2 wall-pin punish on Soraka's self-cost healing, the level-6 Wish reset, first-item burst outracing a single Q-heal, and the late-game sustain inversion.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Equinox as matchup-defining but carries no cooldown number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never states that Equinox (E) landing mid-cast cancels Poppy's Keeper's Verdict channel (missingInteractions: your-channel-punished), nor that Wish/Astral Infusion sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing (missingInteractions: needs-antiheal).
audit.why: Equinox is 20/19/18/17/16s by rank and Wish is 150/135/120s; both real numbers let the reader time an engage or an anti-heal purchase around them.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real Equinox/Wish cooldowns, the channel-cancel interaction, and the anti-heal timing note.
